Account sessions

Research sessions remain private to their initiating account. Shared public source documents do not share research questions.

widget_open

widget_open(path, READ_ONLY)

widget_open returns an owned read-only handle. A missing file returns WIDGET_NOT_FOUND.

Connection retry count

Atlas v1 uses a connection retry count of three attempts.

Old certificate validity

This archived 2020 release used an old certificate validity period of 365 days. Current releases are documented separately.

Changing passwords

Changing your password revokes every existing session and issues a replacement login. Old session cookies stop working immediately.

Connection retry count

Atlas v1 uses a connection retry count of five attempts. This reference describes the same Atlas v1 release as the manual.

Certificate renewal

Current generated local certificates are valid for 90 days and require explicit renewal. An expired certificate causes startup refusal.
